title: The Andhra Pradesh Bio-fertilisers (Monitoring and Quality Control) Act, 2006.
full_text: The Andhra Pradesh Bio-fertilisers (Monitoring and Quality Control) Act, 2006. Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 20066 Act Number: 6 Enactment Date: 2006-01-03 Act Year: 2006 Short Title: The Andhra Pradesh Bio-fertilisers (Monitoring and Quality Control) Act, 2006. Long Title: AN ACT TO PROVIDE FOR THE MAINTENANCE OF SPECIFIED COUNTS OF VIABLE CELLS OF MICROORGANISM, VOLUME OF BIOFERTILIZER AND TO REFRAIN FROM THE PRODUCTION OF CONTRABAND OR SPURIOUS OR PHYTO-TOXI MATERIAL AND DESCRIPTION OF SPECIES OF MICRO ORGANISM IN THE MANUFACTURE OF A PARTICULAR TERMED BIO-FIRTILIZER AND TO MONITOR THE EFFECTIVENESS OF THE PRODUCT IN THE LABEL BY THE MANUFACTURER AND FOR THE MATTERS CONNECTED THEREWITH OR INCIDENTAL THERETO.
